title: Layer 2 round 1 major SE+DE: substrate check downgrades exists-and-referenced to a bare existence probe
description: substrate.rs:68 special-cases only worded-absence; exists and exists-and-referenced both fall to a plain existence check — the referenced half (present AND named by its reference surface) neither checked nor reported inconclusive, and the manifest's declared cross-field constraints go unexecuted. An orphaned payload (file present, wiring clobbered) passes silently, violating the module's own reported-never-silently-passed rule. Disposition: return Inconclusive with a scope note for exists-and-referenced until the reference-surface lookup lands. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: solution-architect.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in d84109f5: exists-and-referenced presence now reports inconclusive scoped to the unverified referenced-by half (absence still fails loudly) — presence never silently upgrades to the full claim; glob matching gained the prefix/suffix length guard against overlap on short names; a home-anchored path with HOME unset is inconclusive, never a fabricated in-repo miss. The temp-tree positive pins the inconclusive set.
